projects.title: scale0 - Autonomous AIOps Self-Healing Platform
projects.description: Architected an autonomous GitOps pipeline orchestrating Generative AI models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) for incident triage. Used LangGraph to gate feasibility and generate structured fix instructions, handing execution to an autonomous code-editing agent (Aider) to patch the repository and open a PR. Engineered a 3-strike self-correction loop using kubectl diff for zero-downtime state synchronization.

projects.title: TrafficWatch (Civic-Tech AI System)
projects.description: Built a real-time computer vision pipeline with YOLOv5 and OpenCV to automatically flag traffic violations from live video feeds. Integrated Tesseract OCR for automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR), passing structured data to a robust backend for validation and reviewer dashboard rendering.

projects.title: DentalAI - Generative AI Clinical Assistant
projects.description: Built a conversational agent using LangChain and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to analyze medical literature. Implemented semantic search via Vector Databases and strict data-privacy protocols to handle sensitive health records securely.

projects.title: BlueLedger - MRV & Carbon Credit Transaction System
projects.description: Designed a Measurement, Reporting, & Verification system extracting EXIF geolocation data to map vegetation sites. Estimated CO2 absorption and issued verifiable carbon credits on Polygon. Built a secure architecture with JWT-based authentication and signed blockchain transactions.
